Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the second WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the movie was *Vidocq*. The WebSurfer search for "Pitof Catwoman video game 2004" explicitly returned a Wikipedia result stating: "Catwoman is an action-adventure video game based on the 2004 film of the same name...". The Planner ignored this direct evidence linking Pitof (who directed the 2004 *Catwoman* film) to a 2004 tie-in game and instead hallucinated that the game was *Vidocq* (a 2001 film), contradicting the search results which confirmed the *Catwoman* connection.
